en: A vintage beige postcard-like card with printed Estonian text. At the top center it reads 'EESTI SPORDI KESKLIIT' and below, a line noting national gymnastics and sports games with dates in June 1934 in Tallinn. On the left is a circular emblem showing athletes with flags and sports gear, encircled by Estonian text. The left side has dotted lines labeled 'Saatja aadress:' for the sender's address, and the right side has a line beginning with 'Tallinn,' followed by space to fill in the year '193...'. There are two punched holes at the bottom edge.
